text:
mae (Docs): opened a tiny PR to add an 'HSM failover + proxy' pattern for airgapped Private installs. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4330. Need infra+sec quick eyes.

vik (Eng-Platform): Couple asks: show checksum verify and a short PKCS#11 probe.

orrell (Eng-Infra): Add a socat tunnel fallback and an nftables passthrough snippet.

hana (Security): Don’t include keys; recommend ephemeral upload tokens and minimal KMS roles.

jess (Support): Ops note: cloud-init can race — suggest ExecStartPre wait loop for DNS/proxy.

ci-bot: CI build OK, linkcheck: missing anchor /private/install/hsm-failover -> 404.

mae (Docs): Draft excerpt: ```
# verify bundle
sha256sum --check offline-bundle.sha256

# pkcs11 probe
pkcs11-tool --module /usr/lib/libpkcs11.so -L

# socat fallback
socat TCP-LISTEN:15000,fork OPENSSL:10.0.5.30:15000,verify=1,cert=/etc/ssl/certs/client.pem
```

mae (Docs): I'll remove stale anchor, add ExecStartPre probe, redact tokens, and push update. Tagging @vik @orrell @hana @jess for quick LGTM after commit. :thumbsup:
